title: VCS React Parity
description: Restore the VCS technology's premigration UI (git tag `premigration`, f8376e84) to the current Rust-plugin → UiNode → React-renderer architecture: the SVG ancestor graph (swimlanes, elbow connectors, commit nodes, author avatars, label chips) in the History window, and the action-button editor surface (+Counter, Commit checkpoint, Undo, Redo, New alternative). Prerequisite: port fork semantics (current_checkpoint_id tracking) into vcs/rs DocumentVcsStore, since HEAD's store cannot branch. Add SurfaceKind::VcsHistory + VcsHistoryScene + VcsHistoryHost, port the premigration lane-assignment algorithm into vcs/rs, restore HistoryTable into ui/js/react/index.tsx, richer seed history with real forks, and a vcs-react-dev launch.json entry.
